summary: Mafl is a self-hosted personal dashboard designed to act as a minimalistic and flexible homepage for your server or browser. It allows you to organise and display your frequently used links and services in a single centralised location. The project is built using Node.js and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want a lightweight, customisable landing page for your local network or self-hosted services without heavy dependencies.
watchOut: The repository exhibits low maintenance activity, which may mean bug fixes and updates are infrequent. You should also consider that it competes in a crowded space with much more actively maintained alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Dockerised Node.js application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your configuration files and map appropriate ports for access. Putting it behind a reverse proxy is recommended if you require TLS termination for external access.
